cohort: At each existing decision clock select nearest eligible zone, then retain first clock at least 300 seconds after previous retained clock; no target-dependent selection.

adaptation.feedback: All outcomes released no earlier than origin+300s, including early hits. Strictly before next prediction. Unknown outcomes never update class counts.
adaptation.combination: Average active-family observed/expected factors with one global factor; no product of correlated hypotheses.

examples.primary: Two nearest-to-centroid X-only prototypes per hypothesis from evaluation/extension, different dates when possible; one may overlap another family.
examples.counterexample: One additional contradicted case per family, nearest to X-centroid; explicitly outcome-selected for explanation, excluded from claims of prevalence.

evaluation.admission: Exploratory predictive atlas on previously inspected dates. No policy, PnL, full-history or live admission.

scope: Fixed five hypothesis templates and X-only thresholds; not a learned hypothesis generator. Existing zone population requires completed visits and excludes inside-zone / first-contact states. Current memory is intraday; no claim of cross-session absolute-place learning. Book evidence is global, not participant intent or target-local defense. No rule or hyperparameter search after observing results.
